description: This file contains unit tests for the Lexer component of the PDFsharp library, specifically testing functions such as number scanning, reverse solidus handling, and PDF document info manipulation.

classes.name: LexerTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the Lexer parsing functions in the PDFsharp library.

methods.name: ReverseSolidusTests
methods.description: Tests the correct handling of reverse solidus characters in PDF strings and ensure proper decoding.

methods.name: ScanNumberTests
methods.description: Performs various tests on the lexer to ensure it accurately recognizes different number formats, including integers, long integers, and real numbers, with boundary and edge cases.

methods.name: Scan_Integer_Tests
methods.description: Tests the lexer for correctly recognizing integer values, including max/min bounds and leading zeros.

methods.name: Scan_LongInteger_Tests
methods.description: Tests long integer recognition, including boundary cases around 64-bit max/min limits.

methods.name: Scan_Real_Tests
methods.description: Tests recognition of real (floating-point) numbers, including scientific-like formats and boundary cases.
